notes.title: Monster College – The Grand Finale is Here!
notes.notes:
After all the laughs, drama, tough choices (and sleepless nights, for me), Monster College has officially reached its final chapter (v1.7.0)!

Whether you romanced vampires, brawled with buff mermen, or just tried to survive your exams... this is where the journey ends.

Well, for now, at least. 👀

V1.7.0 Features:

📖 200.000 words

📸 10.000 images

🎞️ 220 animations

🙏 Huge thanks to everyone who supported the project, gave feedback, hunted bugs, and played it over and over to see every scene. Monster College started as a passion project—but you turned it into something much bigger.

🧪 The story isn’t over yet: Monster City is already in the works, with a new story, new faces, and new temptations... if you would like to make a small gesture to help the success of this new project this is the link to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530770/Monster_City_A_Monster_College_Story/]add it to your wishlist.[/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/c1ba22f6d61f0e836f21ef8cf0926c9964d3c25d.png[/img]

notes.title: The Final Bell is About to Ring…
notes.notes:
Monster College is heading into its final act. After months of awkward flirting, absurd battles, and morally questionable decisions… the ending is almost here.

But are you ready?

💔 Who will you choose?
📸 Can you handle what’s coming next?
😈 And how far are you willing to go for the “true ending”?

🕒 The final update (v1.7.0) drops next week – bringing this wild college ride to its dramatic (and maybe slightly inappropriate) conclusion.

Keep an eye on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2384600/Monster_College/]Steam page[/url].
It’s coming.

🎉 And while Monster College may be wrapping up… a brand-new adventure is just beginning!
I’m getting ready to release Monster City, a spin-off packed with fresh chaos, new characters, and even weirder situations.
👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530770/Monster_City_A_Monster_College_Story/]Wishlist it here![/url]

notes.title: Oliver the Mummy
notes.notes:
Oliver is a mummy with a past rich in history and culture. As the fifth son of a pharaoh, he had a privileged childhood and received a high-level education in writing, mathematics, philosophy and religion. He lived in a time when Egypt was still a powerful country and Pharaoh was seen as a living god.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/25995adc6afc3b82cadf6841d30c672486a1916a.jpg[/img]

Despite his reserved and quiet nature, Oliver is a highly intelligent individual with a profound wisdom that he has acquired over the centuries. Beneath the surface, he has a great sense of loyalty to others, although he sometimes seems detached from other college students.
His resurrection came only a few years ago thanks to an archaeologist who broke the seals of the tomb in which he rested. Since then, he has had to adapt to modern life and has faced some challenges, such as the need to learn new technologies and popular culture. 

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Alex the werewolf
notes.notes:
A werewolf guy who becomes one of your main rivals in college. 
Alex is arrogant, impulsive and often clashes with you. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/542d6294de704611464c3c162b8ae4e52136f3f2.jpg[/img]

You will often doubt him but you must understand the truth and put aside your antipathies.
Alex and Nina are thus officially engaged. Nina belongs to a low-ranking werewolf family, unlike Alex. Theirs is thus a political engagement.

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Kyle the vampire
notes.notes:
Kyle is a vampire of ancient and noble lineage, but he does not seem interested in showing off his prestigious position. Instead, he has a rather relaxed and carefree attitude toward college, preferring to have fun rather than focus on his studies or maintaining his lineage's reputation.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/bb39fea0cdcc48ffa8b963db5286aa94e527d6d5.jpg[/img]

Sometimes he breaks college rules and gets into trouble, but he always has a smile on his face and a ready joke to lift his mood.
Despite his shallow attitude, Kyle is adept at manipulating others to his advantage and knows when to pull out the right cards to get what he wants. He also has a good deal of intelligence and cunning, but often uses it for his own purposes.

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Human hybrids
notes.notes:
The constructed, unthinkably, scientists, builders, thinkers, thanks to their ingenuity to fatality or a mysterious conjunction of factors, give life to inanimate objects, building them a body and bringing from unknown places a soul. All these beings are the constructed, irreplicable works of art forced to take humanoid form and live with other monsters. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/aa220acf372050f3505cc16a6a540f981c31b337.jpg[/img]

Perhaps even Pinocchio would have preferred to remain a log or become a restaurant table to have a quieter life?  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/901d18520e757fd513aef71f1d93452b7dc279dd.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Werewolves
notes.notes:
Werewolves? ...But they are the best in beer and sausage challenges as long as the sausages are raw and the beer ice cold! All the time pushing each other and deciding who is the most worthy pack leader! Muscles in the wind, excellent in sports, they can sniff each other's butts as no race can. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/abcc35f3e4d2a617a78c6c564612443a0e639ea3.jpg[/img]

What more can we say, we might regret the time when they were dressed as furry medieval knights and faced vampires with dignity, getting slaughtered with style and honor by their opponents!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/45b1c72dcca4f84c1efd136053080b0c878213cd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/8419a6405fcf1500a730cadf005cfb2c1fe0d640.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Gorgons
notes.notes:
Gorgons, Medusae, strange mythological creatures that inhabited the seas in the far west, near the realm of the dead, near the Hesperides. 
They are few in all the world, terrifying snakes entwined like hair on their heads, ready to petrify their opponents at a single command of the gorgon. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/7e7715fdd1390d7ba0a08197618ffa0a34a329af.jpg[/img]

The question we all ask is do snakes eat? And instead of shampooing? Do they molt? Why don't they teach these things in the university? 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/f7fc8c57d6b55143db1fcedbf51d492a2109091e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Mummies, Zombie, Skeletons
notes.notes:
Mummies, Zombie, Skeletons? 
Some sorcerer had fun with magic and decided that the bodies of those who had died should come back among us. Necromancy brings them back to life, but rarely does everything go smoothly, there are heads that don't work, decomposed bodies, limbs that fall apart, and not only that.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/9cea0b0b96e9dc5e5c3b83e82428962de171c252.jpg[/img]

Are all necromancers clueless or is necromancy an inaccurate magical science? 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/25995adc6afc3b82cadf6841d30c672486a1916a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Ghosts
notes.notes:
They are few indeed very few, first they were alive then something happened, an accident ? A murder? A sudden illness?
Something kills them too suddenly and for some mysterious reason they remain attached to the earthly world.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/d3d256331208cd9043631d25de46f1888a2663da.jpg[/img]

Their body decays and disappears, but their soul remains alive forever. Undead living with mortals for eternity, is theirs a strange fate?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/86547453d35d6a14692e39403ad2a0c12a56e8a2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Vampires
notes.notes:
Beautiful and damned vampires can be born as such or be created. Fortunately, each vampire can only have one child, otherwise we would be overrun with them due to their immortality.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/9209f310024951270af847095ce948f770c23963.jpg[/img]


Light doesn't kill them, silver doesn't hurt them, churches bore them and some even go there, could we think that the best way to give them death is to make them die laughing? 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/92e051e5ee56465dae2d55a4b17ca990c056695b.jpg[/img]

notes.notes:
I love those horns! Meet Shosha!

Art teacher. Obsessed with artistic perfection, considers MC a perfect male specimen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/14fd6526a7d68e6d3edaa1bce2576878359cdb8c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Lily the gorgon
notes.notes:
Are those snakes? Meet Lily!

Lily is a girl who is highly regarded (actually feared) by other students and professors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/d8a51699668f89ce0b18ca5379244206fde39d10.jpg[/img]

[list]

[*] Lily will try to turn MC against the other girls, speaking ill of them and accusing them of being, for one reason or another, evil.
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Dean Sharp
notes.notes:
An unusual dean? Meet Dean Sharp!

Dean Sharp is a constructed in the style of Frankenstein's wife.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/44f67dbe87be6a1d12214fe98930de82f3f13f17.jpg[/img]

Dean Sharp is a strong and determined woman who has overcome many difficulties in her life. Despite her background, she has managed to make her way in the world of academics and become dean of Silverleaf College.

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:
[list]
[*] She is a natural leader with a strong sense of justice and a commitment to ensuring the success and well-being of the college's students and staff.
[*] Over the years, Dean Sharp has continued to work at Silverleaf College, rising through the ranks to become dean.
[/list]

notes.title: Nina Cohen the werewolf
notes.notes:
Another werewolf? Meet Nina!

Nina is an extremely attractive woman with a breathtakingly athletic body, abundant in every way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/d3cf6c04967d764166d09eef27498962dfd306e6.png[/img]

Nina does not see eye to eye with MC. She has a natural dislike for him, or at least that is what she shows. Inside, her feelings, may be different.

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:
[list]
[*] Nina has been betrothed to Alex, another werewolf. 
[*] Alex and Nina are thus officially engaged. Nina belongs to a low-ranking werewolf family, in contrast to Alex. Theirs is therefore a political engagement. Nina accepted this without objection; in fact, the girl has much respect for the traditions of werewolf families.
[/list]

notes.title: Maxine the zombie
notes.notes:
Never seen a zombie? Meet Maxine!

Maxine is a zombie with some problems in her head. She's not stupid, but her brain works funny and sometimes she gets stuck, forgets things or just has a hard time processing information, so she screws up a lot. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/f1bb9302b7224fddc84f2314814e2292eb269179.png[/img]

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:

[list]
[*] She has a great body and is also very athletic. She is a kind, sincere and humble girl. 
[*] She is attracted to MC's charm, will see in him a good friend and maybe a lover.
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Suzy the goat
notes.notes:
Shy, delicate and a little insecure. Meet Suzy!

Always seeking the compassion of others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/76bd392a8e99c730085bb1617e1303857d6fbf8d.png[/img]

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:

[list]
[*] She is physically very weak, her kind hides in the mountains. 
[*] Suzy is also very polite, well-educated, doesn't swear, and is neat and rational. 
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Grace the mermaid
notes.notes:
Balanced, carefree but responsible. Meet Grace.

Respects people and not even when she enjoys getting them into trouble, never overdoes it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/92572f3cce16ed0e1a542070c99256d7a57b517f.png[/img]

She is not touchy, rarely gets offended or upset, no matter what happens. 


Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:

[list]
[*] She never gets angry and takes everything philosophically. 
[*] Her people live in the depths of the sea. She can breathe even underwater. She likes to attend college, but she also misses deep sea depths. 
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Emily the ghost
notes.notes:
A trusted and reputable ghost. Meet Emily!

Emily like all ghosts cannot reach the afterlife until she resolves an issue left unresolved when she was alive. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/2d8f98b3048149088c104d8fe152b0648f711bc8.png[/img]

Emily knows everything about everyone. She is not a gossip, she simply always finds herself involved in other people's business.  

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:

[list]
[*] Discreetly wise, she often offers to help others. Sentimentally shy, she rarely comes forward when she is interested in someone.  
[*] She is a very intelligent, shrewd and even witty girl.
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Teacher Dragomira
notes.notes:
She is a teacher like no other. Meet Dragomira!

She teaches history in the college. Dragomira hates all werewolves since she had a relationship with one in the past.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/56d04caea27e949b56096d206c5b670e7ec9aa6a.png[/img]

Teacher Dragomira is a strict and authoritarian teacher who does not tolerate any indiscipline or transgression from her students. She loves to exert her power and control over others and makes sure that her students fear and respect her. Despite her sternness, she is also a profound connoisseur of history and strives to impart her knowledge to her students effectively and passionately.

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:

[list]
[*] Dragomira possesses all the powers typical of vampires, including superhuman strength, speed, agility and the ability to hypnotize others.
[*] Her long life has enabled her to accumulate a vast network of contacts and resources among various communities of supernatural creatures, which she can exploit to gain information or favor.
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Olga the librarian
notes.notes:
Do you like reading? Meet Olga!

Olga is a creature constructed from rags, resembling a rag doll. She looks Sweet and gentle, with woolen hair and stitched eyes that express a melancholy sadness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/7ac2391aa7561abc43533324c3785d0596dcc90f.png[/img]

Personality: Olga is a reserved and mysterious librarian who spends her days quietly among the library shelves. Despite her fragile appearance, she is a strong and determined woman with a passion for books and knowledge. 

So here are some quick tips that are sure to get you into Olga's good graces:

[list]
[*] She is kind and caring, but tends to hide her feelings behind a wall of secrecy.
[*] Olga gets aroused by reading books.
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Rachel the vampire
notes.notes:
Do you want to meet a different vampire than usual? Meet Rachel!

Rachel does not like the stereotypical vampire appearance this brings her at odds with her family and other vampires. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/34e984f6b55da37707ef66ec96ea1847771ff872.png[/img]

Rachel does not have many friends as she is considered untrustworthy. She does not keep promises, always arrives late, and cannot be counted on. Rachel is very insecure and always finds it difficult to make even the easiest choices. 

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:

[list]
[*] She is apparently cheerful, but inside she is sad, because she knows her flaws but cannot correct them and is tired of not being well liked by people.
[*] Rachel likes to be submissive, insulted and humiliated. She does this because she unconsciously feels guilty about going against the grain of all other vampires.
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: Sofia the witch
notes.notes:
Do you like witches? They have something mysterious that makes them fascinating. Meet Sofia!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43921087/67a2b1cf127822459bcb13a1486f85e2b8a00921.png[/img]

Sofia is grumpy and distrustful. She trusts no one and is frowned upon by people. Sofia is a natural witch, able to make curses and spells. 

Want to learn more about her? Here are some very useful tips:

[list]
[*] Sofia is brilliant but prejudiced, always sees the worst in people and distrusts everything they tell her. She always thinks there are ulterior motives.
[*] Sofia would like to get out of the shadow she is in and is looking for someone to help her do so. 
[/list]

To learn more about the game visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384600/]community page[/url].

notes.title: News about Monster College!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone guys! I wanted to announce that I am working on the game and it is scheduled for release on July 3, 2023!
I plan to keep you updated until the game's release with game information and news about developments.
Feel free to give me your opinion on what you would like to see in the game!
